dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's your sister Fah like?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts jʊr ˈsɪstər ˈfɑː ˈlaɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's very confident. She's a girl that loves meeting new people.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ˈvɛri ˈkɑːnfɪdənt. ʃiːz ə ˈɡɜːrl ðət ˈlʌvz ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈnuː ˈpiːpəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My mom is a teacher that every student loves. She's very patient.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈmɑːm ɪz ə ˈtiːtʃər ðət ˈɛvri ˈstuːdənt ˈlʌvz. ʃiːz ˈvɛri ˈpeɪʃənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really! But he's calm. He never gets angry.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli! bʌt hiːz ˈkɑːm. hiː ˈnɛvər ˈɡɛts ˈæŋɡri.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is anyone in your family lazy?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ˈɛniwʌn ɪn jʊr ˈfæməli ˈleɪzi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me, on Sundays! I'm a person that loves sleeping in.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː, ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪz! aɪm ə ˈpɜːrsən ðət ˈlʌvz ˈsliːpɪŋ ˈɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fah, sometimes. She eats all the snacks that I buy!
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑː, ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ʃiː ˈiːts ˈɔːl ðə ˈsnæks ðət aɪ ˈbaɪ!
